title: Emrys and the Terminal
author: Vesper Almeida
blurb: Rafael Reyes, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
